scripts.features: Made by @kylosilly!
scripts.script:
local replicated_storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local local_player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local badges = require(replicated_storage:FindFirstChild("Badger"))

if not badges then
	local_player:Kick("Couldnt retrive badges!")
end

for v in next, badges.Badges do
	replicated_storage:WaitForChild("BadgeGot"):FireServer(v)
	task.wait(.5)
end
